note: Original paraphrases of the 12 base-game Equipment cards. Unlock number = card number.

cards.name: Not-Equal Label
cards.text: Place the not-equal (!=) token between two adjacent wires on your stand that have different values. One of them may already be cut.

cards.name: Walkie-Talkies
cards.text: Swap one of your uncut wires with a teammate, face down. Each of you moves the received wire onto your stand. Info tokens travel with their wire.

cards.name: Triple Detector
cards.text: During your Dual Cut, announce one number and point at three wires on a single teammate stand. One match is enough.

cards.name: Post-It
cards.text: Place one Info token in front of one of your own uncut blue wires.

cards.name: Super Detector
cards.text: During your Dual Cut, announce one number and point at every wire on a single teammate stand. One match is enough.

cards.name: Rewinder
cards.text: Move the detonator dial back one space.

cards.name: Emergency Batteries
cards.text: Flip one or two used Character cards face up so their personal items can be used again.

cards.name: General Radar
cards.text: Name a number from 1 to 12. Every player says whether they hold at least one uncut blue wire of that value, answering separately for each stand.

cards.name: Stabilizer
cards.text: Arm at the start of your turn. A failed Dual Cut does not move the dial, and a red wire does not detonate. A wrong guess still places an Info token.

cards.name: X or Y Ray
cards.text: During your Dual Cut, announce two values instead of one. A match on either value succeeds. Can be combined with a Detector.

cards.name: Coffee Mug
cards.text: Instead of your action, pass your turn to any player. The dial does not move.

cards.name: Equal Label
cards.text: Place the equal (=) token between two adjacent wires of the same value on your stand.
